story_type: missing divers found far offshore by infrared, Navy destroyer pickup
hook: Four divers missing 46 miles out at sea.
narration: Four divers were missing, forty six miles out at sea off North Carolina.
A Coast Guard HC-130 crew from Elizabeth City was searching from above.
Then they spotted an SOS strobe light flashing in the water.
The plane's infrared camera reads heat, so a head in the water stands out against the waves.
The nearest ship was a Navy destroyer, the USS Porter.
Her small boat crew pulled the divers out of the sea.
[short pause] Then they brought them back alongside the destroyer.
title: Four divers missing 46 miles out
description:
On Aug. 14, 2023, a Coast Guard HC-130 crew spotted an SOS strobe from four missing divers 46 miles southeast of Cape Fear River, North Carolina, and the Navy destroyer USS Porter brought them aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/893731

facts.claim: Coast Guard and Navy rescued four missing divers 46 miles southeast of Cape Fear River
facts.source_quote: The Coast Guard and Navy rescued four missing male divers 46 miles southeast of Cape Fear River, North Carolina on Aug. 14, 2023.

facts.claim: HC-130 crew spotted an SOS strobe and recorded with FLIR the divers brought aboard USS Porter
facts.source_quote: A Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City HC-130 Hercules airplane crew spotted an SOS-strobe light and, using their FLIR system (Forward-Looking Infrared), were able to record the divers' being brought aboard the U.S. Navy Destroyer USS Porter (DDG 78).
